title: Schedule View grants calendar/appointments/tech assignments (all techs)
config: perms=[scheduleView]
expected: User can view the calendar, appointments and tech assignments for all technicians, read-only.
actual: nav[Schedule]=true, /schedule->/access-denied accessible=false, createBtn=false -> nav shown but page returns Access restricted with this role
notes: FINDING (view-permission gating discrepancy): with the case's exact role_setup (module View ON, all else OFF) the module's nav appears but the module page returns "Access restricted". Live testing shows these module pages require Work Orders View as a companion (adding workOrdersView makes the page accessible; the module View permission alone does not). Customers is the exception (accessible with customersView alone). Expected read-only access; actual access-denied. Likely a permission-gating bug or an undocumented dependency on Work Orders View — for owner triage.
